culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.

laws.rule: In the Hohe Tauern National Park, visitors must stay on the trails, keep dogs on a lead throughout the park, and not make noise. Camping and making fires in open nature are not allowed; campsites in the national park municipalities can be used. Flowers, insects and minerals must be left where they are, and rubbish carried out. The park's page lists no fines and does not state drone or bicycle rules. The park covers parts of Salzburg, Tyrol and Carinthia, and this park-wide rule is held here once.
